title: The Second Shadow
text: One of your Scions casts two shadows. The second moves a moment after the first, and once, in the chapel, it did not move at all when they knelt.

options.label: Have the Apothecary cut the second shadow away before it decides to stay still for good.

outcomes.text: It comes away like wet paper. The Scion sleeps for two days, and the wound on their heel never quite closes.
It comes away clean. Folded in a box, it still moves at night.

options.label: Sit with it in the dark to learn what it knows.

outcomes.text: It knows the way through places that are on no map.
It knows things about the Scion that the Scion did not, and it tells them.

options.label: Keep them out of the light so the second shadow has nowhere to fall.

outcomes.text: Lamps are moved and curtains drawn. The House learns to live in dim rooms.
